units.title: Calcium Homeostasis: RANK-RANKL Physiology and Steps of Bone Remodeling
units.sec: Calcium Homeostasis: RANK-RANKL Physiology and Steps of Bone Remodeling · p224
units.guide: PTH and vitamin D3 stimulate osteoblasts to synthesize RANK ligand (Step-I). RANK ligand activates RANK receptor on osteoclast precursors (Step-II), causing ruffled borders (Step-III) and bone resorption (Step-IV). Resorption then activates osteoblasts (Step-V) and new bone forms at the injury site (Step-VI). Strontium ranelate uniquely increases formation and decreases resorption.

units.title: Bisphosphonates: MOA and Pharmacology
units.guide: Bisphosphonates inhibit farnesyl pyrophosphate synthase in osteoclasts, causing osteoclast apoptosis. They are the DOC when maximum hypocalcemia is needed. Oral absorption is poor, so they must be taken on an empty stomach.

units.title: Bisphosphonates: Route, Dosing and Clinical Uses
units.sec: Bisphosphonates: Route, Dosing and Clinical Uses · p225
units.guide: IV pamidronate every 3 months and zoledronate (preferred, once yearly, longest, most potent) are given for 3 years. Oral risedronate OD and alendronate (preferred OD) are given for 5 years. Osteoporosis DOC is alendronate; if intolerant switch to zoledronate. Hypercalcemia of malignancy and Paget start with zoledronate.

units.title: Bisphosphonates: Side Effects and Prevention
units.sec: Bisphosphonates: Side Effects and Prevention · p225
units.guide: Oral bisphosphonates cause esophagitis — take with a full glass of water and do not lie down for 30 minutes. IV > oral: bone fracture (femoral chalk-stick; DOC teriparatide), maximum hypercalcemia as a paradox, and osteonecrosis of the jaw.

units.title: Denosumab, Raloxifene and Calcitonin Analog
units.sec: Denosumab, Raloxifene and Calcitonin Analog · p225
units.guide: Denosumab is a monoclonal antibody against RANK ligand used in postmenopausal osteoporosis. Calcitonin analog is used intranasally for osteoporosis and S/C for Paget, but increases cancer risk. Raloxifene is a SERM / estrogen agonist on bone.

units.title: Anabolic Drugs and Postmenopausal Osteoporosis Algorithm
units.sec: Anabolic Drugs and Postmenopausal Osteoporosis Algorithm · p226
units.guide: Teriparatide (PTH analog) can cause osteosarcoma, is C/I in Paget, and is limited to 2 years. Abaloparatide is a PTHrP analog. Romosozumab inhibits sclerostin. Algorithm: alendronate DOC → intolerance zoledronate → check fracture risk → high: denosumab; very high: anabolic (teriparatide / romosozumab).
